title: Basava supporters erupt in protest against author Ravi Hanj

ai.summary: Pro-Basava groups protested against author Ravi Hanj's book 'Basava Mantapa' which they claim portrays social reformer Basavanna negatively, staging a flash protest in Bidar where they burned effigies of the author and others involved in the book's release.

facts.claim: Pro-Basava organisations erupted in a flash protest against the 'Basava Mantapa' book authored by Ravi Hanj
facts.quote: Bidar: Various pro-Basava organisations erupted in a flash protest against the 'Basava Mantapa' book authored by Ravi Hanj that, according to protesters, showcases social reformer Basavanna in a poor light.

facts.claim: They staged a protest at Basaveshwara Circle in the city on Thursday
facts.quote: They staged a protest at Basaveshwara Circle in the city on Thursday.

facts.claim: Raising slogans against the author, the pro-Basava activists hit an effigy of Ravi Hanj with slippers and also set it on fire
facts.quote: Raising slogans against the author, the pro-Basava activists hit an effigy of Ravi Hanj with slippers and also set it on fire.

facts.claim: They also set portraits of Shankar Bidari, who took part in the event where the book was released
facts.quote: They also set portraits of Shankar Bidari, who took part in the event where the book was released.

facts.claim: Seers of various mutts, who also took part in the protest, sought immediate arrest of Ravi Hanj for making derogatory remarks about Basavanna and Vachana Sahitya
facts.quote: Addressing the protesters, seers of various mutts, who also took part in the protest, sought immediate arrest of Ravi Hanj for making derogatory remarks about Basavanna and Vachana Sahitya.

facts.claim: Hanj has been writing against Basava ideology, Lingayat religion, Sharanas and mutt heads
facts.quote: Hanj has been writing against Basava ideology, Lingayat religion, Sharanas and mutt heads.

facts.claim: A collection of his articles has been brought out in book form in 'Basava Mantapa'
facts.quote: A collection of his articles has been brought out in book form in 'Basava Mantapa'.

facts.claim: He has also made objectionable remarks during his interview to a media house
facts.quote: He has also made objectionable remarks during his interview to a media house.

facts.claim: Ravi Hanj has termed social reformer Basavanna a thief and liar during his interview to a private channel
facts.quote: Ravi Hanj has termed social reformer Basavanna a thief and liar during his interview to a private channel.

facts.claim: He has made similar accusations on social media
facts.quote: He has made similar accusations on social media.

facts.claim: His insulting remarks on Vachana literature have upset the community
facts.quote: His insulting remarks on Vachana literature have upset the community,

facts.claim: The state government has accorded cultural icon status on Basavanna who is also termed as 'Vishwaguru'
facts.quote: The state government has accorded cultural icon status on Basavanna who is also termed as 'Vishwaguru'.

facts.claim: Many universities even abroad are conducting research on ideologies of Basavanna
facts.quote: Many universities even abroad are conducting research on ideologies of Basavanna.

facts.claim: At a time when the whole world has accepted Basvanna and his ideology it is condemnable that Ravi Hanj a non-resident Indian made insulting remarks on Basavanna
facts.quote: At a time when the whole world has accepted Basvanna and his ideology it is condemnable that Ravi Hanj a non-resident Indian made insulting remarks on Basavanna

facts.claim: Observed Lingayat Mathadhipathigala Okoota president Basavalinga Pattadevaru in Bhalki
facts.quote: observed Lingayat Mathadhipathigala Okoota president Basavalinga Pattadevaru in Bhalki

facts.claim: Scores of papers and books have been published after years of research by the scholars
facts.quote: Scores of papers and books have been published after years of research by the scholars.

facts.claim: Instead of reading them the author has made damning remarks on Basavanna
facts.quote: Instead of reading them the author has made damning remarks on Basavanna.

facts.claim: This is an attempt to insult whole Kannadigas
facts.quote: This is an attempt to insult whole Kannadigas the seer observed.

ai.background_note: Pro-Basava groups in Karnataka have protested against author Ravi Hanj's book 'Basava Mantapa' which they claim portrays social reformer Basavanna negatively, leading to a flash protest in Bidar where effigies of the author and others involved in the book's release were destroyed.
